name: ros-chromium-simulator
description: Lightweight 2D world simulator. Stands in for a real robot: a differential-drive body (TurtleBot3 Burger sized) in a 2D world, speaking the same Roboteq ASCII protocol as robot-base/sim on :8765 (so robot-os-chromium's stack connects unchanged) plus a JSON sensor stream (ground-truth pose + raycast LIDAR) on :8766 for the nav layer (roadmap.md Phase 7). No deps beyond ws; no ROS, no Gazebo.

scripts.test: node test/sim-smoke.mjs && node test/noise-smoke.mjs && node test/slicemap-smoke.mjs
